text.text: Screen for Child Anxiety Related Emotional Disorders Parent Version (SCARED Parent)
For comprehensive information on the SCARED Parent,
The SCARED Parent Items are summed to obtain a raw score for the total and for each of the
five subscales. Average scores are also presented to allow for a comparison between
subscales. Higher scores indicate higher levels of anxiety. A total raw score of 25 or more may
indicate the presence of an anxiety disorder.

- Separation Anxiety (Items 4, 8, 13, 16, 20, 25, 29, 31): measures anxiety related to separation
from attachment figures (typically parents/carers). A score of 5 or above may indicate separation
- Social Phobia (Items 3, 10, 26, 32, 39, 40, 41): evaluates fear and anxiety in social or
performance situations. A score of 8 or above may indicate social anxiety disorder.
- School Avoidance (Items 2, 11, 17, 36): assesses anxiety and avoidance related to the school
environment. A score of 3 or above may indicate significant school avoidance.
On first administration of the SCARED Parent a plot is presented of average scores to enable a
comparison between subscales. Upon multiple administration the progress of therapy can be
tracked using a plot demonstrating the change in average scores over time.
